name: mnox-ai
description: Matt Noxon's curated Claude Code skills and utilities for building, auditing, and refactoring software and AI systems. Install any skill on its own, grab everything with all-skills, or pull a standalone utility.

plugins.name: aio
plugins.description: Agentic Implementation Optimizer — audit, build, or extend agentic AI implementations for reliability, cost, and architecture.

plugins.name: curriculum
plugins.description: Generate an adaptive learning curriculum for any topic, with an append-only assessment loop that tunes future modules to the learner.

plugins.name: strangler-fig
plugins.description: Clean-room legacy reimplementation — distill to requirements, rebuild greenfield behind a context firewall, audit each crossing for leaked legacy structure (taint/provenance), verify parity, optionally cut over.

plugins.name: schema-review
plugins.description: Review database schemas and in-code data structures for correctness, integrity, performance, scalability, and design quality.

plugins.name: compliance-review
plugins.description: Audit a repo, ADR/PRD, IaC, or live cloud state against SOC 2, HIPAA, or PCI-DSS with structured, evidence-backed findings — or assess organizational readiness for a SOC 2 examination (governance, evidence gaps, phased remediation).

plugins.name: util-review
plugins.description: Review Agent Skills, hooks, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files, scripts, MCP configs, or workflow configurations for design flaws, unclosed loops, stale references, and risks.

plugins.name: debut
plugins.description: Pre-public open-source readiness audit — secrets/PII, licensing, community-health files, tests/CI, deps — scored with fix commands.

plugins.name: diagnose-queries
plugins.description: Diagnose slow database queries across Postgres, the ORM layer (N+1), and Snowflake/dbt — five modes from known-query analysis to live-incident triage, ending in a root-caused, verified fix.

plugins.name: ontology-review
plugins.description: Audit a knowledge graph or ontology for structural health across seven axes — orthogonality, granularity, taxonomic hygiene, identity & rigidity, relationship semantics, competency questions, and inference safety — and flag defects before they corrupt inference.

plugins.name: retrieval-review
plugins.description: Audit a retrieval / vector-index / RAG pipeline for quality across seven layered axes — eval foundation, corpus & chunking, embedding geometry, index & ANN fidelity, retrieval composition, rank fusion, and reranking — and flag the defects that silently return wrong or missing context.

plugins.name: foundry
plugins.description: DECOMMISSIONED for public use — the original autonomous-fix loop has been retired in favor of the maintainer's private Sven Unit runtime, which isn't distributed in this repo. Not functional for other marketplace installs; see plugins/foundry/README.md.

plugins.name: all-skills
plugins.description: Meta-plugin that installs every mnox-ai agentic-review skill at once. Standalone utility plugins (session-tracker, config-chunks, create-skill, bash-gate) are installed separately.

plugins.name: session-tracker
plugins.description: Local MCP server that tracks your Claude Code / Cursor / Codex agent sessions — list, search, label, and inspect changes across every session. Lexical (FTS5) search by default; semantic search is opt-in. Requires Bun.

plugins.name: config-chunks
plugins.description: A package manager for agent-instruction guidance — publishes versioned, scored 'chunks', reconciles them into one bundle, and wires it into CLAUDE.md (@import) and/or AGENTS.md (inlined). Ships /ai-setup onboarding and a chunk-review scoring rubric.

plugins.name: create-skill
plugins.description: Author a Claude Code or cross-host Agent Skill end-to-end — scaffold, write against a portable authoring contract, structurally validate, and design-score — in one guided lifecycle. Spec-pure by default; Claude-only features are opt-in.

plugins.name: bash-gate
plugins.description: A PreToolUse gate over Bash that auto-allows provably-safe commands (so you stop approving the same harmless mkdir/rm of a build artifact) and defers anything dangerous to the normal prompt. Deterministic allow-classes by default, an optional LLM arbiter for the long tail, and a /bash-gate-add skill to extend it. Ships safe-by-default — auto-allows nothing until you opt in.
